Subject: Pilot extension options and engineering-credit allocation

Hi Elena / Carlos —

Thanks for the chat earlier. We appreciate how quickly the MedAI team stood up the integration and the early model tests you shared — looks promising. To keep momentum while you finish the final evaluation tests, I wanted to outline two clean options we can execute quickly today so nothing blocks your internal sign-offs:

Option A — 14-day time extension (no change to credits)
- Extend the current pilot window by 14 calendar days from the current end date.
- Same SKU and rate card.
- Useful if you need more sustained live traffic to reproduce a particular edge-case.

Option B — Engineered credit top-up (no time extension)
- Add a one-time pool of 250k token-equivalent credits (applied to the existing pilot account).
- Pilot end date unchanged.
- Helps if you expect a short burst of heavier token usage but want to keep trial timing intact.

We can also do a hybrid: +7 days + 125k credit top-up. That tends to be the compromise most teams prefer.

Operational asks from our side if you go with an extension or top-up:
- Do you need Dedicated support for weekend runs? (we can add a one-off engineering hours block)
- Any regulatory deliverables we should include in the addendum (audit logs, retention window confirmation)?

Attached is a draft addendum that shows the quick legal language for each option and a tiny SOW for 8 engineering hours if you want Redwood to help run the final validation tests. If you confirm which option you prefer, I’ll loop in Legal/Finance and produce a final doc (DocuSign-ready) today.

Quick ask: can you confirm decision by Friday (8/1) so we don’t interrupt the current test harness?

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clear options. Quick context from our side: we have two experiments queued this week that will spike token usage for roughly 48 hours each. We would prefer to keep the pilot end date as-is (so internal PMs have the same calendar timeline) but need the burst capacity.

So Option B (250k credit top-up) is our first choice. If it's possible to split the credits into two earmarked pools (for experiment A and B) that would help our audit trail, but it’s not required as long as there's visibility in the console.

We would also like 6 hours of engineering assistance from Redwood to help validate the second experiment — can you confirm the SOW for that slice?

Carlos and I can sign the addendum once it’s updated with the credit top-up line item.
